title: Lucky: The Dog Who Became the Face of a Movement
excerpt: For nine years, Lucky has been a priceless member of his Vietnamese family. His story — and why his owners decided they could no longer stay silent about the trade threatening dogs like him.
body_html:
Lucky is a purebred Vietnamese Ta dog — nine years old, with the quiet dignity of an animal who has spent his whole life as a treasured family companion. To his owners, he is not a pet in the casual sense. He is a presence in the home, a protector, a source of daily joy. He has a name. He has a history. He is, as his family says, a priceless treasure.

Lucky's story is the reason this campaign exists. Not because his situation is unique — but because it isn't. Across Vietnam, millions of dogs just like Lucky live in exactly this kind of bond with their families. And millions of them are at risk from a trade their owners never consented to.

Pet theft is rampant. Organised networks target dogs in both rural and urban areas. A dog like Lucky — healthy, well-fed, clearly cared for — is exactly the kind of target these networks seek out. The moment he leaves the garden, the risk becomes real.

Lucky's owners decided they could not stay silent. They knew that 95% of Vietnamese people share their values — that dogs are family members, not food — and that this shared belief is the foundation on which lasting change can be built.

This campaign is their voice, and the voice of every Vietnamese family that has lost a pet, or lives in fear of losing one. Sign the petition and stand with them.
author: Campaign Team
